scheme_name: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals
other_conditions: The manuscript or journal must pertain to cultural subjects such as language, literature, philosophy, religion, history, music, dance, drama, or other fine arts
The work must be written in Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, English, or French
The work should be a thesis, dissertation, or original research based on personal study and critical analysis, not intended for obtaining any degree
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 for publishing manuscripts or research journals on cultural subjects.
documents_required: Hard copy of the prescribed application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
